title: Bug fix
description: Reproduce, repair, and test the affected behavior.
guidance: Reproduce the reported behavior and add a focused regression check. Prefer the smallest complete repair; verify touched surfaces and required repository checks.

title: Small change
description: A focused change with a concise proposal.
guidance: Keep investigation and planning proportional to a small change. Propose one recommended approach and only meaningful alternatives. Avoid unrelated refactors or repeated broad verification.

title: Investigate only
description: Gather evidence and stop with findings. No implementation.
guidance: Investigate and report the reproduction, likely cause, relevant files, evidence, remaining uncertainty and recommended next steps. Do not modify source.

title: Cross-repo feature
description: One plan covering contracts and repository dependencies.
guidance: Plan all repositories together, including interface contracts, compatibility, implementation prerequisites, landing order, rollout and rollback. Verify each touched surface and cross-repository interactions.
